purpose: Teach: 列島/知覚/垂直/特異/不利益/中枢/著しい/ノード

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、日本列島の地殻構造を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote that paper on the crustal structure of the Japanese archipelago, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Pause before the topic itself — as if checking her notes or her memory. Warm, not quizzing. The cadence of a teacher confirming rather than testing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、感覚と知覚の違いを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the difference between sensation and perception.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest correction. Steady eye contact. A slight hesitation before answering — not uncertain, but careful to be precise. No defensiveness, just clarity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、垂直農法を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered vertical farming in your paper, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the question. Softer delivery, as if reflecting on what he's said. Not challenging — genuinely puzzling through his research. Curious and a little intrigued.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、特異点の数学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the mathematics of singularities.
lines.style: Direct but not curt. Slight warmth underneath — he's giving the real answer now. Steady pace. No apology, just statement of fact. Eyes meeting hers.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、規制が消費者に与える不利益を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your paper dealt with the disadvantages regulations impose on consumers, didn't it?
lines.style: Engaged, present. Leans in slightly with genuine interest. The pacing is deliberate — she's following the thread of what he's actually studying. Warm but attentive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、神経中枢の機能を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the function of the nervous system's central structures.
lines.style: Assured this time. The smallest lift of confidence in his voice. Still careful, still precise, but less hesitant. He knows what he's talking about. Slight firmness on the core topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 技術進歩の著しい分野を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You wrote about a field experiencing rapid technological advancement, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, measured. A moment of genuine interest — she's noticing the pattern in his work. Warm but observant. Pacing that gives space for his answer. Not leading, just following his path.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、グラフ理論のノード構造を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I researched the node structure within graph theory.
lines.style: Calm but present. A slight closing quality — he's given his answer and settled into it. Not rushed. Warm finish, as if he's relieved to have been understood. Eye contact holds steady to the end.
